title: Hybrid retrieval
content: NeuroFlow combines dense vector retrieval, sparse PostgreSQL full-text retrieval, and optional metadata-filtered retrieval. Dense retrieval compares query embeddings with stored pgvector embeddings. Sparse retrieval uses to_tsvector and plainto_tsquery with ts_rank_cd. The three result lists are combined using weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion. The default fusion constant is 60 and the default weights are 1.0 for dense, sparse, and metadata retrieval. Query expansion can produce additional dense retrieval queries. The fused candidates are passed to a cross-encoder reranker before the final top-k context is assembled.
